defects.description: PRESENT: pre-hook cuts still exchange garment length, cuff wear and fastener treatment rather than maintaining one trucker jacket.

defects.recommended_action: Propagate one approved construction across S01, S03 and S04, preserving source gestures and the specified S04 crop.

defects.description: PRESENT: the lower zipper does not maintain a joined jacket front down to the waistband. The resulting split-front geometry is a closure failure, unrelated to permitted shirt-and-tie visibility at the neck.
defects.evidence: S08@00:26.500 shows separated lower panels; S08@00:27.500 exposes a central V below the zipper; S08@00:28.500 retains the opening during the turn.

defects.description: PRESENT under the existing nonblocking styling exception: shirt/tie variants and S09's pale ribbed cuffs remain. Approved neck-layer visibility is not an open-jacket defect.
defects.evidence: S06@00:17.500 has densely striped neckwear; S09@00:30.500 retains pale ribbed cuffs; S11@00:35.500 uses broader tie stripes and mastic cuffs.
defects.recommended_action: Retain the documented exception. If a later garment regeneration is undertaken, match the approved neckwear and cuff construction without concealing the shirt collar or tie.

defects.description: PRESENT: S08's compact collar and plain jacket body, followed by S12's prominent pocket construction, do not establish one product-faithful Look 1. Accepted late-hook styling differences are not additional release blocks.
defects.evidence: S08@00:24.500 has a shallow collar and high closure; S11@00:36.500 restores a broader standing-collar silhouette; S12@00:39.500 introduces conspicuous pocket shapes below the stripe.
defects.recommended_action: Use one approved garment construction for collar, sleeve treatment, body and pockets. Preserve the approved neck-layer styling and real performance.

defects.description: PRESENT: the city insert separates two visibly different Look 1 realizations. Collar height, closure position, body length and waistband treatment reset on the return.

defects.recommended_action: Match S08 to the approved hook garment anchor before temporal propagation; do not change the insert or performance ranges to conceal the discrepancy.

defects.description: PRESENT: waistband definition and lower-panel geometry still change across sampled poses. The garment does not maintain a consistent sewn hem independently of the remaining mask remnants.

defects.description: PRESENT within accepted late-hook tolerance: collar silhouette, stripe width and body proportions still vary across S09, S11 and S12. These differences are not independently release-blocking.

defects.recommended_action: Retain the existing tolerance; avoid introducing further variants during targeted repairs.

defects.description: PRESENT, reduced: a darker rectangular patch remains visible within the wearer-left band. Missing stripe sections and neck-layer occlusion are no longer reproduced; the residual issue is fabric integration, not lettering.

defects.description: PRESENT: the shirt-tail repair is incomplete. Pale remnants and angular lower-edge discontinuities remain around the crossing hands and central hem.

defects.recommended_action: Rebuild the hand/sleeve/hem occlusion masks from clean garment geometry. Remove underlayer remnants without erasing fingers or inventing a flat painted hem.

defects.description: PRESENT: the moving wearer-right shoulder and upper-arm outline remains eroded into a stepped cutout rather than a continuous fabric silhouette.

defects.recommended_action: Restore the shoulder/upper-arm matte from the source silhouette, retaining natural motion blur and separating the hand correctly.

defects.description: PRESENT: the standing collar exposes tan inward-facing surfaces instead of the required navy interior. The mastic exterior and visible neckwear do not excuse the facing-color mismatch.
defects.evidence: S06@00:17.500 exposes both tan inner collar faces; S06@00:19.500 retains them during the lean; S06@00:20.500 makes the inward-facing color especially clear.
defects.recommended_action: Generate navy only on the collar's interior-facing fabric, preserving the mastic exterior, standing shape and visible shirt collar/tie.
